words.d: strange and a bit scary, in a quiet unsettling way
a thin white layer of ice crystals on everything
the moment when the sun comes up in the morning
to say what will happen before it happens
the fading light just before night
covered in thin fog that hides things
the evening moment when the sun goes down
from the hot wet regions near the equator
the line leading to a place
the process of taking in and letting out air
to become less clearly visible
the season when leaves fall from the trees
a deep yellow color
having a circular shape
an energetic attempt to achieve something
different from what is normal or usual
to be good enough for what it costs

a light refreshing breeze

to become loose and part from something

videos.desc: A static night shot looks over a floodlit rail freight yard while a deep red glow pulses in the dark clouds on the horizon. The glow swells into a bright burning ball lighting the sky blood-red, then slowly shrinks and fades as wind howls over the scene.

On a freezing sunrise morning, boots crunch over grass coated white with frost as a couple walks through a garden leaving dark footprints. They admire a frosty spiderweb, wipe an icy layer off a white bench, show a leaf edged in ice crystals and draw a line in the frost with a finger, saying 'Cool, cool, cool.'

A round animated bird sits on a balcony rail above a city, then takes off over the roofs; the shot holds on the low sun sitting on the horizon and throwing long golden rays across the rooftops as the bird shrinks to a dot flying straight into the light.

In a hand-painted anime seaside scene, a woman points up at a single dark cloud and calmly gets her yellow umbrella ready while the man beside her scoffs "No chance!". Seconds later rain pours down exactly as she said; she stays dry under the umbrella and he laughs, admitting "You knew it!".
videos.said: No chance! Oh! Haha! You knew it!

videos.desc: A telescope view of the moon against a black sky scattered with faint stars. At first only a small pale disc shows in the corner of the frame. The camera zooms in steadily until the moon fills most of the picture: a large round grey body with its curved bright edge on one side, the darker flat plains in the middle, and thousands of small craters picked out along the shadow line.

A fast drone shot at sunset. It sweeps over a dry clifftop past a single wide tree, where a woman in a white dress stands looking out to sea. It tips over the edge and dives towards a turquoise bay with a natural rock arch in the headland, then races low across the water past a lone swimmer. In the last shots the camera skims the sea surface straight towards the sun on the horizon, and the water and the cloudy sky are one sheet of deep warm yellow light.

A bearded man in a bright orange jacket and a grey beanie stands on a grassy clifftop above a grey, white-capped sea. The wind rips his scarf out sideways and flattens the grass; he grabs at his hat to stop it flying off, turns his back to the gust, then bends forward and pushes himself uphill step by step, bracing his hands on his knees as the wind shoves him back.

A woman in a bright patchwork ski jacket and striped hat stands on packed snow high in the mountains, the Matterhorn sharp against a deep blue sky behind her. She looks straight into the camera, purses her lips and breathes out hard, and a thick white cloud of warm air bursts from her mouth and drifts away in the cold. She does it again, laughing, and other walkers standing further back on the snow do the same, so several white puffs hang in the air at once.

A bearded man in a checked jacket stands in a park under a huge maple tree whose leaves have turned bright yellow. He tips his head back and looks up into the branches. Yellow leaves start drifting down through the frame, and he holds out both hands to catch them as they fall past him. The ground around him is already carpeted in fallen yellow leaves, with red and orange trees behind him and people walking in the distance. At the end he bends forward, laughing, as the leaves keep coming down.

A woman in a soaking wet orange hooded raincoat films herself on a grassy hillside above a lake, grinning and pointing back over her shoulder at a full rainbow arching right across the grey sky. She turns to look at it, and second by second the colours grow weaker: first the left hand side thins out, then only a short faint band is left low on the right, and then the sky is empty and grey. She keeps standing there in the wet grass looking at the place where it was.

Filmed from inside a car looking out of the open window across an empty marked car park. The sun sits low on the horizon at the end of the tarmac and floods the whole shot with orange light, throwing a long shadow behind a woman walking towards the car. She is barefoot in a white summer dress and carries a flat pizza box in both hands; she comes up to the window smiling, leans in and hands the pizza box through it while the sun goes down behind her.
videos.said: I bring your pizza. I am your sunshine today.

videos.desc: A calm forest lake in fading evening light, the sun already gone behind the pine treeline and the sky still warm orange. A man in green shorts leaps off the end of a wooden jetty and lands in the water with a ring of spray. More people then run down the jetty and throw themselves in one after another, each raising a burst of white splash, until several heads are bobbing in the dark water while the last daylight drains out of the sky.

A street fruit seller in a conical straw hat stands behind an enormous pyramid of yellow and green mangoes stacked on her stall on a hot Vietnamese street, with scooters and shophouses passing behind her. A brass pan balance hangs on chains beside the fruit. She smiles, takes a mango, and holds open a brown paper bag; a close-up shows hands dropping spiky red rambutans into the bag over a bed of more rambutans and mangoes. A wide shot shows the whole mango pyramid with a pineapple perched on top under a blue awning. At the end she laughs happily and reaches across the wooden counter to hand the bag over.

A short travel montage of a young woman in a mustard-yellow raincoat. First she leans out of a red telephone box on a city street, one arm raised in a wave, with a huge clock tower behind her and a red double-decker bus passing. Then she is out on a green hillside where low grey cloud sits right down on the hills: the far slopes fade into white haze and the long lake in the valley below is half swallowed by it, so you cannot see where the hills end. She walks along the ridge in the drizzle, looking out over the hazy valley. Finally she stands on a wooden seaside pier under a clear blue sky, laughing and eating chips out of a paper cone with the surf rolling in behind her.

A selfie on a tropical beach covered in snow under a grey sky. A young woman with dark wavy hair, wearing a coral bikini top and a thin gold necklace, stares into the camera with her mouth open in shock as snowflakes fall. A clump of snow drops from a palm tree behind her; she shuts her eyes, looks up at the sky with her mouth open, then stares at the camera again. A thatched sun umbrella, turquoise sun loungers and a straw hat are dusted white, and the turquoise sea rolls in.

On a rainy street in the evening, in front of dark stone buildings with pointed arches and balconies, a young woman in a burgundy leather jacket and a black skirt laughs, staying dry under a sturdy navy umbrella with a curved wooden handle. Beside her a young man in a soaked light blue shirt holds up a cheap black umbrella blown inside out, its thin spokes bent, looks up at it and pulls a face. The wet pavement reflects the street lamps, and a black and yellow taxi is parked behind them.

In a narrow stone street of a seaside town after a big storm, a wooden fishing boat with a tall mast lies stranded in the road next to a parked car, hung with seaweed, while seagulls fly around it. Seaweed, white crates and rubbish cover the wet road, and water gushes out of a doorway onto the pavement and slowly stops. A young woman in a jumper and green wellies holds a broom by a shop door and stares up at the boat with her mouth open. Further down, two men stand in the street near a black dog and an armchair.

On a whitewashed terrace above the sea in soft evening light, a light wind blows the long white curtains of the doorway out into the air. Pink petals float past and a straw hat rolls across the stone floor. A young man in an open white shirt lies on a built-in bench with a blue cushion, a book in his hand, and smiles as the breeze moves his hair. A shell wind chime sways, a young woman leans on the white wall by a domed chapel, and a cat walks past a table with a water jug.

At a bus stop in heavy evening rain, about ten people in jackets and hoods squeeze tightly together under the small glass shelter roof: a woman holding a cake box, a man with a bicycle and a cyclist in a helmet. At the edge a laughing young man in a wet white T-shirt holds a paper bag over his head as water pours off the roof onto him, and the people huddle even closer. Red double-decker buses with their lights on come along the shining wet street under the streetlights.

At a wooden beach bar during a sudden storm, with dark clouds, bending palm trees and big waves, a young woman in a white tank top, denim shorts and a belt bag clings to a wooden post with both arms while the strong wind lifts her feet off the ground. Above her, a large piece of the corrugated metal roof tears loose, lifts away from the edge and flies off. Green plastic chairs tumble across the sand, a man works behind the bar, and another woman with a dog braces against the wind.

Wide golden wheat fields at sunset lie under a huge storm cloud with a thin tornado on the horizon. A flattened track of bent wheat and a dirt road run through the fields towards the storm. A young woman in a plaid shirt and shorts stands on the roof of a dusty white pickup with her arms raised, and a young man sits beside her pointing at the tornado. A dark car drives up the dirt road in a cloud of dust and she turns to look. A red barn and a silo stand far away.

A small lighthouse stands at the end of a pier on a freezing winter day. The whole tower is wrapped in a thick coat of ice, with long icicles hanging from its gallery and roof. A wave crashes against it, throwing up white spray, and the water runs back over the icy pier. The railings along the pier are coated in heavy ice. A snowy shore with a small wooden hut and frosted trees lies behind, gulls fly past and low sunlight breaks through dark grey clouds.

A young woman in a black swimsuit stands waist-deep in milky blue water in a steaming outdoor hot spring while snow falls. With her eyes closed and her head tilted up, she holds out her open hands to catch the snowflakes, lowers her hands to the water, breathes out and lifts them again. Flakes land on her eyelashes, wet hair and bare shoulders, and steam rises around her. Snow-covered black lava rocks and a white hillside fade into the mist behind her.

At night in a storm, a white lighthouse with dark bands stands at the end of a stone harbour pier. Its lamp shines a bright starburst of light, goes dark while a huge wave crashes against the rocks and throws white spray high into the air, and then shines brightly again. A small light on a marker in the water blinks once. Water pours off the pier as the wave falls back. Dark water churns around the harbour, the masts of small boats poke up below, and a coiled rope lies on a bollard.

On a city street on a very hot evening, a young woman in a white blouse and dark pencil skirt stands barefoot on wet cobblestones holding her black shoes, while cool spray from a burst water pipe showers over the crowd and makes a rainbow. She opens her mouth, throws her arms wide and laughs up into the water. Office workers in suits with briefcases stand around her in the mist, a dog lies on the wet pavement and rolls onto its back, and a red double-decker bus waits behind in the golden low sun.

On a flooded town street in the rain, a young woman in a yellow rain jacket and dark waders strains to push a heavy sandbag onto a long wall of sandbags, while brown floodwater gushes through a gap and splashes over the cobbles at her feet. She then steps back, wipes her face with her arm and smiles, mud on her cheeks. Beyond the wall the river has risen over the road and a car is sunk up to its windows. Workers in yellow and orange safety vests pass more sandbags along the line behind her.

On a stormy seaside promenade, a young man with wet curly hair, in a yellow raincoat, grey jumper, jeans and white trainers, leans far sideways against a metal railing in the strong wind, laughing with his fists up, as a paper coffee cup and leaves fly past. Behind him a woman in a dark coat holds on tightly to a lamp post, a couple sits on a bench, an umbrella blows away inside out and a dog stands by them. Big waves crash over the sea wall near beach huts and a pier, and the man comes closer as he laughs.

On a seaside promenade during a tropical storm at dusk, palm trees bend hard in the wind and huge waves crash over the sea wall, throwing spray across the path. Muddy sea water then floods over the paving around a striped blue and white deckchair that has been blown across it, among scattered coconuts, torn palm leaves, flip-flops and a red toy bucket and spade. A pastel cafe with boarded-up windows and an empty lifeguard hut stand by the rough grey sea.

On a snowy office rooftop between tall glass towers, a young man in a white shirt, tie and sunglasses, trousers rolled up, leans back in a striped deckchair in the one narrow beam of sunshine, his bare feet in a small inflatable paddling pool, holding an ice cream cone and enjoying the sun. Colleagues in winter coats and scarves stand behind him laughing, some filming with their phones. A pigeon sits on the snowy ledge beside an air-conditioning unit.

From under a tin roof during a heavy tropical downpour, thick streams of rain pour off the roof edge and pound onto a muddy street full of brown puddles. Water gushes from a pipe and splashes onto the muddy ground right beside an old rusty oil drum. The rain keeps falling across the street, where bicycles lean against a wall under a sagging cloth awning, stacked plastic crates are covered with plastic sheeting, and banana trees stand in the grey mist.

On a seaside promenade on a stormy day, four very different young people walk along the wet paving in a row, and the strong wind blows all of them in the same way: a man in a cream suit, a young man in a black wetsuit carrying a white surfboard, a cook in a white hat and blue apron who holds her hat, and a woman in a lilac top. Their hair flies sideways and yellow leaves swirl around them. Waves crash behind the blue railing and a gull hangs in the grey sky.

A ski resort in winter with almost no snow. The view starts close on white ski boots on skis in a muddy puddle and rises to show a young woman in a blue puffer jacket, red scarf and black trousers standing on skis on green grass. The mountain slopes behind her are brown and bare, and only a small glacier is left near the rocky peak. A snow cannon sprays a cloud of white mist, and an empty chairlift and a wooden hut stand nearby. She pulls on her gloves and looks around.

An open grassy airfield under dark stormy clouds. An orange and white striped windsock on a tall pole stands straight out to the right, blown stiff by a strong wind. A small tree beside it is bent over the same way, the long grass is flattened to the right, and loose leaves fly through the air at first. The view slowly rises from a muddy track with puddles towards the windsock and the moving clouds, with a low barn and trees on the horizon in the evening light.

A frozen lake in winter at sunrise. A young man in a navy bathrobe stands barefoot on the snow and shakes out a wet towel; water sprays off it and the towel stiffens and turns white with frost. A young woman in a maroon puffer jacket laughs and reaches out to touch it. Behind them a woman in a blue swimsuit climbs a ladder out of a square hole cut in the ice and stands on the edge, hugging herself in the cold. Frosted birch trees, fairy lights and a red wooden cabin stand behind.

A low view in a sunny park looking up at a clear blue sky. Two white vapour trails left by two high planes cross each other and form a large X in the middle of the sky. The viewer's arm in a blue sleeve points up at the exact crossing point, then a laughing young woman in a lilac top and a young man in an open white shirt join in and point at it too, and a frisbee flies past. Green grass, a picnic blanket, pink blossom trees and a church spire are at the bottom.
